description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generated for ZavaQueueBridge Azure modernization.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest .NET LTS framework.
tasks.reason: The project runs on legacy .NET Framework and the request explicitly requires modernization to the latest framework.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10 and convert to SDK-style project format while preserving current file processing behavior.

tasks.description: Modernize queue publishing from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native service modernization requires replacing broker dependencies with Azure-native messaging.
tasks.requirements: Migrate RabbitMQ publish flow to Azure Service Bus and keep message payload/routing semantics aligned with current processing expectations using Managed Identity authentication.

tasks.description: Modernize local file ingestion to Azure mounted storage.
tasks.reason: The workload currently depends on local file paths and should adopt cloud-native storage integration.
tasks.requirements: Replace hard-coded local filedrop assumptions with Azure mounted storage paths while preserving existing polling and file lifecycle behavior, using Managed Identity where applicable.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is mandatory for every modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions; document major-version risks and verify build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.reason: The request explicitly requires deploying the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the upgraded and transformed application to Azure Container Apps with managed identity-based service access and production-ready configuration.
